description: sigstore_core CI record (req-boot-bootstrap-ci-record, tap#365) — the stack this plugin's own tests run in, and the one claim per-plugin CI is allowed to make: that sigstore_core is correct against the dependencies it DECLARES and nothing else. Install set is exactly the depends_on closure (identity_core) plus sigstore_core itself; the consumer flips the self entry to editable so the CHECKOUT under test runs, not the pinned revision. Population is empty: this plugin ships no GRIFT to seed. DELIBERATELY EXCLUDED: every other plugin, all credentials, all required_secrets, and any population step that reaches the network — so a fork can run this lane and a nightly cannot flake on a third party (req-boot-bootstrap-ci-record-5). Reproduce CI exactly: spawn --from 'git+https://github.com/unified-systems-com/sigstore-core-tap@<release tag>#ci' --dev-plugins sigstore_core
